guide.reason: Bambu Lab's filament guide has no column for plain PETG: its columns are PLA, PETG HF, ABS, ASA, PC, the TPUs and the fibre-filled grades. PETG HF, a high-flow PETG and a product of PETG here (m141, D86), is its one unfilled PETG and the nearest column, so a PETG product whose own sheet and twin are silent reads it, labelled as the guide's. It is a high-flow grade's window (nozzle 230 to 260 °C, bed 60 to 80 °C), which a plain PETG's own sheet may set lower. Not PETG-CF, a column of its own, nor PETG-GF, -ESD, PCTG, CPE or PET, which the guide does not name.
